svg.text: Atrial-content interventions on SR recipients: within-record logit change (modified - original), record-level 95% CI
Filled = real intervention; hollow = matched sham (same location, per-lead energy, spectrum; random phase). Donor/sham realisations averaged within record first.
C. SR recipients: other classes, real minus matched sham (paired)
D. AFIB recipients (secondary): AFIB logit change
n SR recipients (eligible) = 466; n AFIB recipients = 77. Condition-specific n differ because of quality control (see acceptance).
